also.summary: USTR excess-capacity probe findings due; duties expected on China, EU, India, Japan.

also.summary: Portal still running while unauthorised-access reports are investigated.

also.summary: Gold earnings up from $4.2bn the previous fiscal year, ministry reports.

also.summary: Platforms must remove harmful content or face up to 5% of global revenue.

also.summary: FT reports a fund investing mainly in AI and quantum; Reuters could not verify.
